custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Part Number with the new number.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  7. Open work order 1 from the Work Orders list (Work Orders in the top bar).
  8. Click the Parts tab of work order 1.
